info.name: SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) SAP BRIM Convergent Charging Balances Rating API
SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) Rate a usage event

items.docs: Rates a single usage event against the applicable pricing plan and returns the calculated charge. Supports real-time and batch rating scenarios.

info.name: SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) Rate a batch of usage events

items.docs: Rates multiple usage events in a single request for high-throughput scenarios. Returns individual rating results for each event.

info.name: SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) Simulate rating without committing

items.docs: Simulates the rating of a usage event without persisting the result. Useful for quote generation and what-if analysis.
